**Methodological description (English):** Separate a description of observed behavior, a forecast about future behavior, and a proposed mechanism responsible for it.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 行動を記述すること、予測すること、原因を説明することの違いを学ぼう。

##### 歴史的な心理学のアプローチ

[historicalPsychologicalApproaches.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/historicalPsychologicalApproaches.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate foundational schools of thought in their historical context and assess why some claims have been revised by later evidence.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 証拠が増えるにつれて初期の心理学理論がどう発展したか探ろう。

##### 心理学のさまざまな視点

[psychologicalPerspectives.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/psychologicalPerspectives.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare how behavioral, cognitive, biological, developmental, and sociocultural models explain different aspects of the same phenomenon.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 異なる心理学的アプローチが同じ行動をどう説明するか比べよう。

##### 心理科学の研究範囲

[scopeOfPsychologicalScience.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/foundationsAndPerspectives/skills/scopeOfPsychologicalScience.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the empirical study of behavior and experience from philosophical evaluation of arguments and from medical diagnosis or treatment.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 心理学研究と哲学、臨床的な治療の違いを見分けよう。

#### 測定と標本抽出

Skills: 5

[measurementAndSampling.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/measurementAndSampling/measurementAndSampling.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Operational measures offer imperfect indicators of psychological constructs, and recruitment choices limit generalization.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 心理学者が心理的な概念をどのように測り、研究参加者を選ぶか学ぼう。

[constructValidity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/measurementAndSampling/skills/constructValidity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether a test actually captures the intended psychological attribute rather than a convenient proxy.

**User-friendly description (ja):** テストが測ると主張する概念を本当に測定しているか評価しよう。

[measurementBias.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/measurementAndSampling/skills/measurementBias.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify systematic distortions from test wording, cultural assumptions, inaccessible formats, or observer expectations.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 測定が特定の人を一貫して不利に扱ったり、誤って表したりする仕組みを見つけよう。

[operationalDefinitions.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/measurementAndSampling/skills/operationalDefinitions.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Translate an abstract concept such as stress or attention into an observable indicator and identify what it leaves out.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 抽象的な心理学の概念を観察可能な測定指標に置き換えよう。

[reliabilityOfMeasures.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/measurementAndSampling/skills/reliabilityOfMeasures.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ja):** 心理尺度が一貫した結果を示すか確かめよう。

[representativeSampling.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/measurementAndSampling/skills/representativeSampling.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how sampling, recruitment, and nonresponse affect the generalizability of findings.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 標本の集め方によって母集団への結論がどう制限されるか考えよう。

#### 研究倫理

Skills: 7

[researchEthics.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/researchEthics.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Studies involving people must respect autonomy, dignity, safety, and confidentiality, including additional safeguards for vulnerable participants.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 研究が人々の自己決定、尊厳、安全をどう尊重できるか学ぼう。

**User-friendly description (ja):** 研究で情報を伏せることがどんな場合に倫理的に認められるか考えよう。

**User-friendly description (ja):** 研究への参加に同意する前に何を知る必要があるか考えよう。

[researchAnonymity.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/researchAnonymity.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain when collected data cannot be linked to a participant and why this differs from merely promising confidentiality.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 匿名の研究データと秘密が守られた情報の違いを区別しよう。

##### 研究における秘密保持

[researchConfidentiality.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/researchConfidentiality.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how identifiable participant information may be protected through access restrictions and careful reporting.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 研究者が個人を特定できる参加者データをどう守るか学ぼう。

[researchDebriefing.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/researchDebriefing.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the purpose of a meaningful post-participation explanation and support when a study withheld important information.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 研究後に参加者への十分な説明が必要になる理由を考えよう。

##### 脆弱な立場の参加者を対象とする研究

[researchWithVulnerableParticipants.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/researchWithVulnerableParticipants.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ja):** 子どもや脆弱な立場の参加者に必要な追加の保護を知ろう。

##### リスクと利益の評価

[riskBenefitAssessment.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/researchEthics/skills/riskBenefitAssessment.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify possible distress, coercion, stigma, and privacy harms and consider less intrusive alternatives.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 研究による利益の可能性と苦痛、被害、強制のリスクを比べよう。

[studyDesigns.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/studyDesigns/studyDesigns.data.ts)

**User-friendly description (ja):** 研究デザインによって導き出せる結論がなぜ異なるのか学ぼう。

[blindingInResearch.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/psychologicalScienceAndInquiry/studyDesigns/skills/blindingInResearch.data.ts)

### 感覚と知覚

Groups: 5 · Skills: 23

[sensationAndPerception.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/sensationAndPerception.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sensory information is detected, selected, organized, and interpreted into an experienced world. Psychological perception differs from simple measurement of physical stimuli or anatomy of sense organs.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 感覚信号がどのように周りの世界の体験になるか探ろう。

#### 身体感覚と化学感覚

Skills: 6

[bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts](../../../content/psychology/data/skills/sensationAndPerception/bodyAndChemicalSenses/bodyAndChemicalSenses.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Touch, pain, balance, body position, smell, and taste rely on partly distinct receptor and processing pathways. Their psychological importance lies in how signals become conscious experiences and guide action, not in cataloguing anatomy alone.

**User-friendly description (ja):** 触覚、痛覚、嗅覚、味覚、身体の感覚が体験をどう導くか探ろう。

**User-friendly description (ja):** 痛みの体験が一つの組織からの信号だけでは決まらない理由を考えよう。
